lcc_original: 瑪勒列在世的日子、共有八百九十五年，然後死。
notes: 日子 explicitly renders {<WH03117>} (יְמֵי) in LCC — braces dropped per Rule 3; 在世的 is a LCC expansion with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
共有 split: 共<WAH03605> = כָּל (all/total), 有<WAH01961><WTH8799> = הָיָה (were/had) with morphology code kept on the verb
Hebrew שָׁנָה (WH08141) appears twice in the source — first instance (after מֵאוֹת/百) has no explicit LCC word so kept as {<WH08141>} implicit; second instance attaches to 年
然後 (then/after that) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated; 死 alone receives WH04191+WTH8799
